Name: CK's Holder Tractor
Author: clefairykid
Description:
>> [url=https://ko-fi.com/A506M39]if you like my work, you can support me on ko-fi.com via this link[/url] <<

A Holder tractor design that can be used to replace the default tractor image found in Pathoschild's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url], or even used to replace the default horse if you prefer. 

[b]REPLACING THE TRACTOR IN THE TRACTOR MOD[/b]
1. Unzip the image and ensure it is correctly called "tractor.png"
2. Copy and paste the image into the correct folder of the Tractor Mod by Pathoschild (select replace, or delete the old one first)

Tractor Mod > Assets > tractor.png


[b]REPLACING THE DEFAULT HORSE[/b]
1. Unzip the imagine and rename it to "horse_4.png"
2. Download and install the AdoptSkin mod by Gathouria 
3. Copy and paste the horse_4.png to the Horse folder in the AdoptnSkin Mod folder;

AdoptSkin > Assets > Skins > Horse > horse_4.png

4. Follow the detailed instructions on the AdoptSkin mod page to select the correct horse and the correct horse skin.
